items.title: Ledger attack spreads to EU, AI finds '18 trillion XRP' bug: Hodler's Digest
items.summary: An user reports buying a tampered Ledger from a big retailer in Europe. Security researchers use AI to uncover a '$94 billion' XRP bug but receive just a $250K bounty.

items.title: Saylor teases Strategy Bitcoin buying after ending September with STRC buybacks
items.summary: Investors will have to wait an extra day to find out if and how much Strategy added to its Bitcoin treasury in the first week of October.

items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Coldcard says it's investigating how phishing link appeared on its X account
items.summary: Company advised users not to visit or interact with the link in question and said it will share any further verified updates.

items.title: Ledger confirms unauthorized hardware implant, says losses may exceed $86M
items.summary: Ledger said the incident appeared to be isolated to a single reseller and its Southeast Asian market.

items.title: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling
items.summary: The two measures attempt to set the stage for a potential US Supreme Court battle over federal and state jurisdiction.

items.title: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
items.summary: An IMF analysis found that more than half of tokenized stock trading happens outside U.S. market hours, though the roughly $2.3 billion market remains more volatile and less liquid than traditional equities.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana ETFs All in the Red for October
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $386.3 million in net outflows through the first seven trading days of October, while Ethereum funds have now posted nine straight days of losses.

items.title: How Zcash Plans to Hide Your Keys From AI and Quantum Attacks
items.summary: Zakura, a Zcash full node developer, says it expects hash-based signatures to land in Zcash in January, and is rolling out a privacy tool for rotating transparent addresses this week.

items.title: CFTC Draws the Line Between Prediction Markets and Gambling in New Rules
items.summary: A proposed rule would expressly fold event contracts tied to sports, politics, culture and weather into the swap definition, while an interim rule excludes casino-style gambling.

items.title: This Sam Altman-Backed Life Insurer Runs Entirely on Bitcoin, and Just Raised $37.5 Million
items.summary: The Bermuda-based insurer, which runs entirely on Bitcoin, drew the funding from existing backers led by Bain Capital Crypto after a record year driven by demand from wealthy families.

items.title: Here's a Way to Predict When AI Chatbots Will Turn Bad
items.summary: Physicists at George Washington University say a formula can estimate when an AI chatbot will flip from good answers to bad ones, and early tests on small models back it up.

items.title: Trader nets $1.28 million on new 1,000x exchange Papertrade by moving Hyperliquid's ETH prices
items.summary: The same wallet later lost $450,000 when 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night after staying open for more than three hours.

items.title: XRP Ledger patches decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP
items.summary: An overflow bug in the XRP Ledger's payment engine could have let an attacker mint about 18 trillion spendable XRP in one transaction.

items.title: Kalshi is investigating bets on Trump's press secretary pick placed before announcement: WSJ
items.summary: Three bets totaling about $173 were placed before news outlets reported Zacharia's pick and are expected to pay out roughly $9,600 combined.

items.title: Ether ETFs extend outflow streak to nine days as Solana funds snap record 14-week inflow run
items.summary: Spot bitcoin, solana, and ether ETFs all logged weekly outflows following last week's trading, a notable shift for some of the funds.

items.title: Former FTX COO says Netflix's 'Altruists' trailer 'made me physically throw up'
items.summary: Former FTX COO Constance Wang says Netflix's The Altruists misrepresents FTX's collapse and turns it into a love story.

items.title: Blockchain.com seeks CFTC greenlight for US prediction markets, crypto derivatives trading: CNBC
items.summary: Blockchain.com has applied for DCM and FCM licenses to offer ahead of a planned $500 million IPO.

items.title: Starknet considers leaving Ethereum for a quantum-resistant Layer 1
items.summary: Starknet's STRK token more than doubled over seven days while developers considered leaving Ethereum to build an independent Layer 1 blockchain.

items.title: Optimism's Unichain deal will put more chains under one operator
items.summary: The October migration would concentrate more chain operations at Optimism, while Ethereum fallback routes depend on each chain's deployed contracts.

items.title: Some Aave loans sit near liquidation with collateral that can take hours to cash out
items.summary: October 9 borrower snapshots put the focus on whether collateral sales or redemptions can fund stablecoin repayment.

items.title: XRP's next Wall Street expansion comes with an unexpected complication from Ripple
items.summary: Management retains cost less impairment, so an unrealized XRP price rise alone will not lift earnings by revaluing the holdings.

items.title: Lightning apps using unpatched LDK risk Bitcoin theft from a reconnect lie
items.summary: The October 1-dated v0.2.7 and v0.1.13 patches close a reconnect theft path, while v0.2.7 also fixes an LSPS2 payment-amount flaw.

items.title: Some Kraken futures limit orders can still fill after a successful cancel
items.summary: The October 8 Maker Protection expansion brings more contracts under a rule that discards unfilled remainders while still allowing execution.

items.title: Bitcoin Life Insurer Meanwhile Raises $37.5M as Wealthy Families Look to Pass On Their BTC
items.summary: The Bermuda-regulated startup, whose backers include Bain Capital Crypto and Sam Altman, has now raised more than $180 million.

items.title: 'We Know Where It Is': Treasury Secretary Threatens To Freeze $1B of Iran's Crypto
items.summary: The U.S. will seize $1 billion of Iran's crypto this week, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has said. It isn't clear which asset though.

items.title: Here's How Not To Screw up Your Bitcoin Privacy
items.summary: Speaking on the Bitcoin Rails podcast, Cake Wallet's Seth for Privacy said people need to take more precautions to protect their identities when using the biggest cryptocurrency.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $729M in Two Days as Investors Reverse Course
items.summary: Investors have fast cashed out of bitcoin exchange-traded funds this week. It's showing in the price.

items.title: Ledger Warns Buyers Not to Set Up Wallets From Reseller After Users Report Losses
items.summary: Hardware wallet manufacturer Ledger is investigating after users reported having wallets drained.

items.title: UTXO's Loren Asmus: The $300T Bond Market Is Bitcoin's Next Frontier
items.summary: UTXO Management's Loren Asmus: Bitcoin isn't a trade, but a portfolio staple. He breaks down institutional adoption, retention, and why education is key.

items.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
items.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

items.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
items.summary: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

items.title: Dark web drug market operator sentenced to 40 years, forfeits $101 million in bitcoin
items.summary: A man from Virginia, who facilitated millions of drug transactions worth roughly $430 million, agreed to give up $100 million worth of BTC. His partner forfeited nearly 1,600 BTC.

items.title: MARA transfers $81.1 million in bitcoin to Galaxy Digital as strategy pivots to AI
items.summary: The bitcoin miner's transfer does not confirm a sale, but comes as its treasury has fallen from 53,822 BTC in February to 35,577 BTC in August.

items.title: Sam Altman-backed bitcoin insurer Meanwhile secures $37.5 million in Bain Capital Crypto-led round
items.summary: Meanwhile has signed 15 brokers serving high-net worth clients across markets in Switzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips from day's highs, set to close week with a loss
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs lost $244 million on Thursday and the ZEC fund extended a run of October outflows. Bitcoin is back near $82,000 after a $1 billion liquidation.
